data.name: Arslan
data.gender_notes: Arslan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arslan is a powerful name of Turkic and Arabic origin meaning 'lion'. It symbolizes bravery, strength, and courage — traits admired in warriors and leaders. The name Arslan carries the meaning “Lion, Brave, Courageous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Arslan usually hope their child will grow to embody lion, brave, courageous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents spiritual bravery and leadership, reflecting a courageous heart and noble soul.
data.etymology: Arslan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion, Brave, Courageous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arslan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أرسلان
in_arabic.meaning: الإسم الأصلح المضغوط، الإسم العالي، الإسم المجهول، الإسم القوي
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصل الإسم من الإسم العالي الذي يرمز للاستحقاق، والإسم المجهول الذي يرمز للحكمة، والإسم القوي الذي يرمز للقوة، والإسم المضغوط الذي يرمز للشجاعة، في بعض الأحيان يرمز للإسم أرسلان إلى الإسم العالي الذي يرمز للجلالة.

in_urdu.name: ارسلان
in_urdu.meaning: اچھا نام، بڑا نام، مجھول نام، قوت والا نام، شجاع نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: ارسلان نام کے معنی ہیں اچھا نام،بڑا نام، مجھول نام، قوت والا نام، شجاع نام، یہ نام عرب سے آیا ہے اور اس کے معنی ہیں اعلیٰ نام، جو ایک نام ہے جو ایک شہزادے کے لیے مخصوص تھا، اس نام کا مطلب ہے چھوٹا، شجاع، اچھا، خوش مزاج، ایک شہزادے کے لیے یہ نام بہت زیادہ مشہور ہے اور اسے بہت سے ممالک میں پسند کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.long_meaning: आर्सलान नाम का अर्थ सर्वश्रेष्ठ नाम, उच्च नाम, अज्ञात नाम, शक्तिशाली नाम, शूरवीर नाम होता है। यह नाम अरबी से आया है और इसका अर्थ है उच्च नाम, जो एक शहजादे के लिए विशिष्ट नाम था। इसका अर्थ है छोटा, शूरवीर, सर्वश्रेष्ठ, अच्छा, खुशमिजाज, एक शहजादे के लिए यह नाम बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसे बहुत से देशों में पसंद किया जाता है।

in_english.name: Arslan
in_english.meaning: Best name, high name, mysterious name, powerful name, brave name
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arslan means best name, high name, mysterious name, powerful name, and brave name. It is derived from the Arabic root word Arsalan, which means to be exalted, to be high, to be mysterious, to be powerful, and to be brave. In Islamic tradition, the name Arslan is associated with strength, courage, and wisdom. It is said to be a name of good omen, and is often given to boys born into noble families. In modern times, the name Arslan has become popular across many Muslim cultures, and is often associated with qualities such as intelligence, confidence, and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arslan has been popular across different cultures throughout history, most notably in Turkey and Central Asia. In Turkish folklore, there is a legendary figure named Ertugrul Ghazi, who is believed to have used the title Arslan during his rule as the bey of Söğüt. Furthermore, the name can be found in various works of literature, cinema, and music. Its association with strength and courageousness makes it a desirable name for those who want to embody these traits.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the lion often appears in hadiths, sayings of the Prophet Muhammad, symbolizing power, courage, and fearlessness. Muslims may see the name Arslan as a reflection of the spiritual attributes of courage and strength, representing their faith in God and their resilience in the face of life's challenges. The name can inspire you to face adversity and remain steadfast, just like a lion that protects its pride.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Arslan means "lion-hearted" or "heroic" in Turkish, reflecting a courageous and valiant spirit. In the Islamic context, it symbolizes the inner strength and determination of a true believer, facing life's challenges with honor and dignity.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Arslan was the name of several sultans in the Seljuk Empire. The name Arslan carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The Seljuk Empire was a Turkic state based in Anatolia (modern-day Turkey) that existed from the late 11th to the late 14th century.

trends: Arslan is a popular name in Turkey and other Muslim countries
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Arslan remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
